create_config_granitemoeshared: create a GraniteMoeSharedConfig instance with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers
init_model_from_config: initialize a GraniteMoeSharedModel using a GraniteMoeSharedConfig with MoE expert parameters
configure_moe_experts: configure MoE settings including num_local_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and router_aux_loss_coef
set_scaling_multipliers: set embedding_multiplier, logits_scaling, residual_multiplier, and attention_multiplier on the config
access_config_from_model: access the model configuration via model.config after model initialization
